prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production environment-only full-scene background plate for a hand-painted 2.5D game. Use the provided B03 gameplay preview as the authoritative rendering and GROUND COLOR reference, especially its very light warm cream / warm pale-gray limestone paving.
Paint ONE cohesive landscape scene, exactly 3:2 aspect ratio, preferably 3072 x 2048. This is one continuous sunny village plaza, NOT an atlas, not a panorama strip, not repeated tiles, not a contact sheet, not a boxed diorama sitting on a colored background. Full image is opaque finished artwork. NO HUD, NO text, NO characters, NO monsters, NO item drops, NO buff beacon, NO mailboxes, NO carts, NO tea tables, NO interaction lamps and NO movable furniture: those are separate game sprites placed by the engine later.
Match the reference's high three-quarter near-isometric game camera, soft warm upper-left sunshine, clear hand-painted outlines and beautifully readable 2.5D forms. Daytime cozy Pumpkin Town, whimsical intact cartoon undead village, never spooky. Walls/building fragments cream and mint, roofs soft lilac, plants fresh mint-green, a few orange pumpkins and tiny white/lilac flowers. However the PAVING must overwhelmingly be cream limestone and WARM PALE GRAY like the reference, not lavender/purple paving and not a saturated gold/orange carpet.

EXACT GAMEPLAY COMPOSITION:
The normalized rectangle x=0.11 to 0.89 and y=0.13 to 0.87 is ENTIRELY unobstructed walkable stone ground. It occupies 78% image width and 74% height. Paint absolutely no building, fence, tree trunk, raised flowerbed, furniture or terrain hole inside that rectangle. Stones stay level, continuous and gently textured. It should look rich through varied irregular stone sizes, subtly chipped edges, tiny natural grout, very occasional moss between stones and quiet soft sun patches, NEVER through objects in the center. Keep center contrast gentle so game actors and attack cues remain readable. No circular repeating medallions, no evenly repeating seams, no long gold/yellow vertical lines, no central crest or raised pedestal.
Along the OUTERMOST 8–12% edges, make one coherently connected town scene with uneven organic edge transitions. A few low naturally placed grave-garden fence FRAGMENTS, small irregular pumpkin-and-white-flower garden curves, glimpses of two or three DIFFERENT lilac-roof cottage corners/eaves, and a couple dappled tree-canopy shadows are allowed only outside the walkable rectangle. The stone paving continues naturally toward these edges, interleaving with grass and pale earth. Do not paint four straight walls around a rectangular arena.
At both LEFT MIDDLE and RIGHT MIDDLE, y=0.32 to 0.68, create very wide completely open village-lane connections continuing beyond the frame; no fence, gate, house or tree blocks these openings. They are flat extensions of the SAME cream stone paving, not colored bands.
The TOP border contains a little irregular patch of mint garden at top-left, a cropped cottage eave near top-center-right, and a slightly different small cottage corner far top-right, with substantial open stone spaces between them. No full straight skyline row.
The BOTTOM edge contains low organic pumpkin foliage near bottom-left and a small white-flower patch near bottom-right, with a broad stone path continuing between them; any foreground leaves are bright, delicate and low. No full continuous hedge strip across the bottom.
Four edges must belong to the SAME image perspective, daylight and street geometry. Give edges different distributions and rhythms rather than mirrored corners or repeated stamps. Little hat-shaped grave stones may occur only TWO or THREE times in the entire exterior, all different shapes, never an identical skull fence row. No skull motif repetition and no dark black outlines around the whole arena. Do not create a uniform green/gray/purple background ring or any plain horizontal band.

Materials and rendering:
Warm ivory and pale warm-gray irregular stones dominate at least 80% of total visible image. Subtle thin light-gray stone joints, softly painted shadows, small surface age details; calm sunny readable floor. Purple and mint are accents on peripheral roof tiles, foliage and a few seams only, never the main ground hue. Outer foliage naturally overlaps soil irregularly; no clipped square patch at the edge. No hard rectangular cutoff, no artificial ground-to-background contrast strip, no stretched floor texture pretending to be a tall wall. Buildings are only small peripheral architectural glimpses consistent with the approved preview, not newly invented landmarks occupying the center.

Strict avoid: no HUD or words, no people/zombies/ghosts, no collectibles or furniture, no repeated cutout-object fence perimeter, no rows of identical headstones or identical trees, no uniform color ring or stripe, no gold vertical seams, no gray void, no dark night scene, no big blurry foreground leaves, no rectangular pool or pit, no central raised terrain, no walls inside the clean walkable rectangle, no industrial machinery, no wire coils, no random prop scatter. A complete production ground-and-outskirts plate whose neutral cream stone color and natural town border truly match the approved preview.
